hints: After taking away 50, how much is left?
60 − 50 = 10, and 10 is 2 more fives.

items.prompt_en: Guess first: is 618 ÷ 6 closer to 10 or to 100?
items.prompt_hi: Pehle guess karo: 618 ÷ 6, 10 ke paas hai ya 100 ke?
items.answer: Closer to 100 (it is 103)
hints: What is 6 × 100?
6 × 100 = 600, which is close to 618.
618 ÷ 6 is just over ___.

items.prompt_en: When you shared 72 into 4 groups, why did you change some tens into ones?
items.prompt_hi: Jab tumne 72 ko 4 group mein baanta, toh kuch dahaai ko ekai mein kyun badla?
items.answer: 7 tens give each group 1 ten with 3 tens left; those 3 tens cannot be shared as whole tens, so they become 30 ones, and with the 2 ones that is 32 ones, 8 for each group

1 hundred, 1 ten, ___ ones.

items.prompt_hi: Golu ne 92 ÷ 4 aise kiya: 9 ÷ 4 = 2, aur 4 ÷ 2 = 2, toh 22. Kya yeh sahi hai?

After 9 tens ÷ 4, 1 ten is left; it becomes 10 ones.

items.prompt_en: Show 45 ÷ 3 as an array with 3 rows. How many are in each row?

3 rows of 10 use 30; 15 are left, 5 more for each row.
15 in each row: 3 rows of 15 make 45.

items.prompt_en: 130 children go to the transport museum in vans. Each van takes 8 children. How many vans are needed?
items.prompt_hi: 130 bachche van se transport museum jaate hain. Har van mein 8 bachche baithte hain. Kitni van chahiye?
items.answer: 17 vans
hints: How many full vans can 130 children fill?
8 × 16 = 128, so 2 children are still waiting.
16 full vans + 1 more = ___.
17 vans: 16 are full and one more takes the last 2 children.

items.prompt_en: A 75 m rope is cut into pieces of 5 m. How many pieces?
items.prompt_hi: 75 m ki rassi ke 5-5 m ke tukde kiye. Kitne tukde bane?
hints: How many 5 m pieces are in 50 m?
50 m gives 10 pieces, then 25 m gives 5 more.
15 pieces.

items.prompt_en: Teach Golu how to divide 256 by 2, and how to check the answer.
items.prompt_hi: Golu ko sikhao 256 ko 2 se kaise bhaag dein, aur answer kaise check karein.
items.answer: Share hundreds, tens, ones: 2 hundreds ÷ 2 = 1 hundred; 5 tens ÷ 2 = 2 tens with 1 ten left; 16 ones ÷ 2 = 8: 128; check 128 × 2 = 256
hints: Which place should Golu share first?
Talk about the leftover ten and checking by multiplying.
1 hundred, 2 tens, ___ ones = ___; check ___ × 2.
Share place by place to get 128, then check: 128 × 2 = 256.

items.prompt_en: Quick! 69 ÷ 3?
items.prompt_hi: Jaldi batao! 69 ko 3 se bhaag do?
hints: Share the 6 tens by 3.
2 tens each, then 9 ones ÷ 3 = 3.
2 tens and 3 ones = ___.

hints: What does one cloud stand for?
Count by 5s for each cloud.

items.prompt_en: Tally marks show two full bundles of five and 3 single lines. How many is that?
items.prompt_hi: Tally marks mein paanch-paanch ke do poore bundle aur 3 akeli lines hain. Kul kitne hue?
hints: How many does one full bundle show?
Two bundles of 5 and 3 more.

items.prompt_en: Key: 1 cricket ball picture = 10 runs. A batter's row shows 6 balls. How many runs?
items.prompt_hi: Key: 1 cricket ball ki picture = 10 run. Ek batsman ki row mein 6 ball hain. Kitne run?
hints: How many runs does one ball picture stand for?
Count by 10s for each ball.
60 runs.

items.prompt_en: Key: 1 mango picture = 4 mangoes. A row has 3 pictures and half a picture. Guess first: is that 3, three and a half, or 14 mangoes?
items.prompt_hi: Key: 1 aam ki picture = 4 aam. Ek row mein 3 pictures aur aadhi picture hai. Pehle guess karo: 3, saadhe teen, ya 14 aam?
items.answer: 14 mangoes
hints: What do the 3 whole pictures stand for?
3 × 4 = 12; half a picture is half of 4.
14 mangoes: 12 from the whole pictures and 2 from the half.

items.prompt_en: Why do we need the key to read a pictograph?

items.answer: Graph A: 5 pictures; graph B: 2 pictures

5 pictures.

diagnostic.prompt_en: The scale goes up in 2s (0, 2, 4, 6...). A bar is 5 squares tall. What does it show?
diagnostic.prompt_hi: Scale 2-2 karke badhta hai (0, 2, 4, 6...). Ek bar 5 square ooncha hai. Woh kya dikhata hai?

diagnostic.prompt_en: The scale is 0, 10, 20, 30. A bar ends exactly halfway between 10 and 20. What is its value?
diagnostic.prompt_hi: Scale 0, 10, 20, 30 hai. Ek bar 10 aur 20 ke theek beech mein khatam hota hai. Uski value kya hai?

items.prompt_en: In a bar graph of votes for class monitor, Asha's bar reaches the 12 line. How many votes did she get?
items.prompt_hi: Class monitor ke votes ke bar graph mein Asha ka bar 12 ki line tak pahunchta hai. Use kitne vote mile?
hints: Where does the top of the bar reach?
Read the number on the scale level with the top of the bar.
The top is at ___.
12 votes.

items.prompt_en: Asha got 12 votes and Bilal got 8. How many more votes did Asha get?
items.prompt_hi: Asha ko 12 vote mile aur Bilal ko 8. Asha ko kitne zyada vote mile?
hints: Who got more?
Find the gap between the two bars.
4 more votes.

items.prompt_en: The bars show Asha 12, Bilal 8, Chitra 15 and Dev 5 votes. Who won, and who got the fewest votes?
items.prompt_hi: Bars dikhate hain Asha 12, Bilal 8, Chitra 15 aur Dev 5 vote. Kaun jeeta, aur kisko sabse kam vote mile?
items.answer: Chitra won; Dev got the fewest
hints: Which bar is the tallest?
Tallest bar is the most votes; shortest is the fewest.
Tallest: ___; shortest: ___.
Chitra won with 15, and Dev got the fewest with 5.

items.prompt_en: Dev's bar is drawn very wide but it is short. Chitra's bar is thin but tall. Guess: who got more votes?
items.prompt_hi: Dev ka bar bahut chauda par chhota bana hai. Chitra ka bar patla par lamba hai. Guess karo: kisko zyada vote mile?
items.answer: Chitra
hints: Which part of a bar shows the number?
Only the height against the scale counts.
The taller bar is ___.
Chitra: her bar is taller, and height shows the votes.

items.prompt_en: Why does only the height of a bar matter, and not its width?
items.prompt_hi: Bar ki sirf oonchai kyun maayne rakhti hai, chaudai kyun nahi?
items.answer: The numbers are on the scale going up the side, so the top of the bar against the scale gives the value; widths are drawn the same just to look neat
hints: Where are the numbers written on a bar graph?
The scale runs up the side, not across the bottom.
We read the number at the ___ of the bar.
The scale goes up the side, so only how high the bar reaches tells its value.

items.prompt_en: Graph A's scale goes 0, 1, 2, 3 … Graph B's scale goes 0, 5, 10, 15 … In both graphs, a bar reaches the 3rd line above 0. What does each bar show?
items.prompt_hi: Graph A ka scale 0, 1, 2, 3 … hai. Graph B ka scale 0, 5, 10, 15 … hai. Dono mein ek bar 0 ke upar teesri line tak pahunchta hai. Har bar kya dikhata hai?
items.answer: Graph A: 3; graph B: 15
hints: What is each step worth in graph B?
In B, every line is 5 more.
3 in graph A and 15 in graph B: same height, different scale.

items.prompt_en: The scale goes 0, 10, 20, 30, 40. A bar for mangoes sold stops halfway between 20 and 30. How many mangoes?
items.prompt_hi: Scale 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 hai. Bike aamon ka bar 20 aur 30 ke theek beech mein rukta hai. Kitne aam?
hints: What number is halfway between 20 and 30?
Halfway between two marks 10 apart is 5 more than the lower one.
25 mangoes.

items.prompt_en: The scale goes up in steps of 5. Bilal's bar is 4 squares tall. I said Bilal got 4 votes. Am I right?
items.prompt_hi: Scale 5-5 ke steps mein badhta hai. Bilal ka bar 4 square ooncha hai. Maine kaha Bilal ko 4 vote mile. Kya main sahi hoon?
items.answer: No. Each square is 5, so he got 20 votes
hints: What is each square worth on this scale?
Each square is a step of 5.
No: 20 votes, because each square stands for 5.

items.prompt_en: Turn this table into bars in your head: Monday 10 cups of chai sold, Tuesday 20, Wednesday 15. The scale goes up in 5s. How many squares tall is each bar?
items.prompt_hi: Is table ko dimaag mein bars mein badlo: Monday 10 cup chai biki, Tuesday 20, Wednesday 15. Scale 5-5 karke badhta hai. Har bar kitne square ooncha hoga?
items.answer: Monday 2, Tuesday 4, Wednesday 3 squares
hints: How many 5s make 10?
Divide each number by 5.
2, 4 and 3 squares tall.

items.prompt_en: A bar graph shows rainfall: June 120 mm, July 250 mm, August 180 mm. Which month had the most rain, and how much more than June?
items.prompt_hi: Ek bar graph baarish dikhata hai: June 120 mm, July 250 mm, August 180 mm. Kis mahine sabse zyada baarish hui, aur June se kitni zyada?
items.answer: July, 130 mm more than June
hints: Which bar is the tallest?
July has the most; find the gap with June.
July had the most rain, 130 mm more than June.

items.prompt_en: Asha got 12 votes, Bilal 8, Chitra 15 and Dev 5. How many children voted in all?
items.prompt_hi: Asha ko 12 vote, Bilal ko 8, Chitra ko 15 aur Dev ko 5. Kul kitne bachchon ne vote diya?
hints: Add or subtract for 'in all'?
Add all four bars.
40 children voted.

items.prompt_en: Teach Golu how to read a bar graph whose scale goes up in 10s.
items.prompt_hi: Golu ko sikhao jis bar graph ka scale 10-10 karke badhta hai, use kaise padhein.
items.answer: Look at the scale first; each mark is 10 more; go to the top of the bar and read across to the scale; if it stops halfway between marks, it is 5 more than the lower mark
hints: What should Golu look at before the bars?
Talk about the scale steps and bars that stop between marks.
Each mark is ___; halfway between marks is ___ more.
Check the scale first (steps of 10), read across from the top of each bar, and halfway between marks means 5 more.

items.prompt_en: Quick! On a bar graph, what tells you the number: the bar's height or its width?
items.prompt_hi: Jaldi batao! Bar graph mein number kaun batata hai: bar ki oonchai ya chaudai?
items.answer: Its height
hints: Where is the scale?
The scale runs up the side.
We read the ___.
The height of the bar.

workedExample.problem: A bar graph of kites sold has a scale going up in 5s. Monday's bar reaches 25 and Tuesday's bar reaches 40. How many more kites were sold on Tuesday?
steps: Check the scale: each step is 5.
Monday's bar reaches the 25 mark, so 25 kites.
Tuesday's bar reaches the 40 mark, so 40 kites.
40 − 25 = 15, so 15 more kites were sold on Tuesday.
